//: tsconfig.json required to configure TypeScript for Astro, React
required by React which in turn requires JSX
dev/pages-removed-details is generated by dev/remove-details.mjs and
is gitignored. The copies sit one folder deeper than the pages they
come from, so their relative imports do not resolve and the type
check reports errors about files nobody wrote. dist is inherited from
the Astro base config and has to be repeated because naming exclude
here replaces it rather than adding to it.
